products.summary: The NEXBODY X60 is a professional body assessment system designed for fitness centers, wellness facilities, and personal training studios, delivering precise body insights for personalized fitness and wellness solutions.
products.name: NEXBODY Nexbody-X60

story.title: Professional Body Assessment Solutions for Fitness & Wellness
story.body: Explore the NEXBODY X60 in action across fitness centers, wellness facilities, and rehabilitation settings, supporting professional body assessment and personalized wellness solutions.

specs.label: Languages
specs.value: Chinese, English, French, Thai, Russian, Portuguese, Spanish and Ukrainian; additional languages customizable

features: Automatic anatomical landmark recognition with manual correction
Posture Assessment covering angles, asymmetry, risk levels, and scoring
Body Composition Analysis with nearly 40 metrics and segmental insights

Automated Body Assessment with voice guidance and position recognition
Assessment Reports & Data Management supporting sharing, printing, branding, and data upload

seo.title: X60 Body Assessment System | NEXBODY
seo.description: Discover the NEXBODY X60 Body Assessment System, featuring body composition analysis, posture assessment, and mobility evaluation for fitness and wellness professionals.

highlights: Forward head posture, head lateral tilt, uneven and rounded shoulders
Pelvic tilt, knee hyperextension and leg alignment
Weight, muscle, protein, fat, BMI, BMR, WHR and segmental composition

products.summary: The NEXBODY OneScan is a professional gait analysis system designed for rehabilitation clinics, sports performance centers, and wellness facilities, providing detailed gait insights to support movement assessment and personalized care.
products.name: NEXBODY OneScan
products.tagline: Precision Gait Analysis. Smarter Movement Insights

story.title: Pressure becomes a movement record.
story.body: The dedicated walkway captures plantar-pressure distribution, center-of-pressure trajectory and timing through the gait cycle.

features: Static plantar-pressure and dynamic gait assessment
Readable analysis reports for clinical and training workflows
Batch data import and export with open API interface
Optional integration with insole-customization data services

seo.title: OneScan Gait Analysis System | NEXBODY
seo.description: Discover the NEXBODY OneScan Gait Analysis System, designed for gait assessment and movement analysis in rehabilitation clinics, sports centers, and wellness facilities.

highlights: Step timing, cadence and temporal and kinetic parameters

story.title: From scan to downstream action.
